atom_environments_observed.rule: every row of the file, one per environment the inventory displays

atoms_an_edit_touched_or_built.rule: every row of the file, one per atom an edit touched or built

atoms_kept_as_they_were_and_merely_touch.rule: rows whose role is retained and touched: the edit changed what their bonds spend and nothing else about them

body_atoms_held_in_a_ring_the_core_cover.rule: the sum of ring_shared_count over the file

bond_environments_observed.rule: every row of the file, one per bonded pair the inventory displays

component_instances.rule: every row of the file, one per body component of one ion

core_selection_decisions_recorded.rule: every row of the file, one per decision point per accepted core

cores_accepted.rule: every row of the file, one per accepted core

cores_supported_by_the_fewest_members_al.rule: the cores count on the row whose support is the floor in force

definitions_accepted.rule: the sum of accepted over the file

definitions_offered.rule: the sum of offered over the file

definitions_refused_by_the_terminal_halo.rule: the sum of terminal_halogen over the file

definitions_refused_for_being_above_the_.rule: the sum of above_lowest_valence_with_hydrogen over the file

definitions_surviving_the_atom_environme.rule: the sum of surviving_after_atom_environment over the file

definitions_surviving_the_bond_environme.rule: the sum of surviving_after_bond_environment over the file

definitions_surviving_the_valence_ledger.rule: the sum of surviving_after_ledger over the file

distinct_products_at_the_reported_allowa.rule: distinct product_smiles among certified rows at order_index at most 50

elements_an_edit_may_place.rule: distinct element among the creatable rows

examinations_at_the_reported_allowance.rule: rows whose order_index is at most 50

families_a_floor_of_three_would_leave_wi.rule: the families_left_with_no_core_at_all on the floor-of-three row

families_retained.rule: distinct family_id among the retained rows

families_with_more_than_one_core.rule: rows whose core count exceeds one

ions_a_core_reached.rule: every row of the file, one per ion a core matched

largest_library_component_heavy_atoms.rule: the largest heavy_atoms in the file

median_similarity_between_a_product_and_.rule: the median of similarity_to_parent over certified rows, unrounded

of_those_the_number_whose_total_valence_.rule: retained and touched rows whose total valence before equals total valence after. The ledger is one subtraction and it requires this of every one of them, so any shortfall is a defect and not a result

perception_check_mismatches.rule: rows whose agrees flag is 0, which must be none

products_certified_at_the_reported_allow.rule: rows whose order_index is at most 50 and whose certified flag is 1

products_refused_by_certification.rule: every row of the file, which is expected to be empty

ring_environments_observed.rule: every row of the file, one per (bond order, ring size) pair

sequential_roots.rule: every row of the file, one per core

signature_collisions.rule: every row of the file, which must be empty

source_entries_read.rule: every row of the file, one per source entry

note: Every value above was computed by reading the file named beside it. The paper quotes this table and nothing else.
